name: Firsencode Network Users
author: Firencode

sections.description:
On a multisite network, users are listed per site. Firsencode Network Users adds one network-wide table where super admins can:

  • see each user’s membership on every site of the network, with the role on that site;
  • filter by any role (Administrator, Editor, Author, Contributor, Subscriber and custom roles);
  • search by email, username or display name;
  • remove selected users from selected sites in bulk. Accounts are not deleted, and super admins and your own account are always skipped.

The plugin adds no settings, database tables or front-end code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin in Network Admin → Plugins → Add New and click Network Activate.
  2. Open Network Admin → Users → Network Users.
sections.faq:
Does it work on single-site installations?

No. It is a network-only plugin for WordPress multisite.

Does “Remove from site” delete the user?

No. It removes the user’s membership (and role) on that site only, like the Users screen of the site. The account and its content stay. To delete accounts, use Network Admin → Users.

Is it suitable for very large networks?

The table reads users from every site on each page load. It works well for networks with up to a few hundred sites; on larger networks, filter by role or search to keep pages fast.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Renamed from “Multisite User List” to “Firsencode Network Users” (slug firsencode-network-users).
  • Fix: users on sites beyond the first 100 of the network were not listed.
  • Fix: the bulk action could remove super admins and your own account from sites; they are now skipped, and a summary is shown.
  • Changed: the screen moved to Network Admin → Users → Network Users; the bulk action is now called “Remove from site”.
  • New: filter by every role of the network, search by username and display name, translatable interface.
  • Code: function names prefixed, input sanitized, “Network: true” header.

1.0.0

  • First stable release.
